headline: Fisherman's Row Line Turns; Expanse and Shelf Grind On
war_summary: Fisherman's Row, set at seven squares to two in the last edition, now reads seven Colonial squares with two laid waste: forty-six base events in the day and sixteen in the past two hours, the busiest ground on the map. Stlican Shelf holds its split at four Warden squares against five Colonial, with forty-four events in the day and Breaker Town alone claiming thirty-one. The Weathered Expanse remains the war's furnace — forty-eight events in twenty-four hours, four in the past two, casualties near 1,107 Colonial and 1,658 Warden an hour, Warden colors on two squares and Colonial on seven. Callahan's Passage keeps stirring: eight events in two hours and twenty-four across the day, with two squares now no-man's-land among eight Warden. Linn Mercy reports Warden losses near 1,051 an hour against 330 Colonial, its eleven squares Colonial. Nevish Line stands seven Warden squares to one Colonial under sharp fire. Of fifty-three regions, six show more than one color; Colonial banners cover most of the remainder.
